items.label: Including the AIClient Library
items.content:
Including the AIClient Library

To use AIClient in browser environments, include the following script tag in your HTML. This makes the AIClient class available globally.

html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>

### What Happens When You Load This Script
- The AIClient library is initialized in the page.
- AIClient becomes globally accessible.
- No module bundlers or build steps are required.

### Requirements
- Include this script before any code that uses AIClient.
- This version is only for browser environments; it is not a Node.js package.

items.label: Initializing AIClient
items.content:
After including the library, you can initialize AIClient like this:

```javascript
const client = new AIClient({ apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY' });
```

- `apiKey` is your personal API key.
- No additional build steps are needed for browser usage.
